newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE robusta coffee quietly mixed at noon.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE robusta coffee quietly mixed at noon.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures moved narowly to end Friday midsession tightly mixed and traders said the market could stay in a tight range upto the close in the absence of fresh news and the holiday closure in New York.
"The range is small and we expect no improvement in the afternoon," said a floor trader. "There is no fresh news and the market is waiting for Monday afternoon to see what New York has to offer."
September, the London benchmark, drifted within a $15 band to end the morning break unchanged at $1,795 a tonne. But other traded months were $3 up to $5 down.
On the charts, the London contract could attempt to push higher and break out of a tightening range but may not have enough upside momentum to sustain the move.

"The range is tightening...but on a tightening like this you normally have quite a good move at the end of it," said Susan Rigg at Chart Analysis. "I wouldn't be at all surprised if it didn't try to rally but I'm not sure it's going to get very far."

According to U.S. forecaster WSC, cold air building over Argentina on Friday was expected to pass off to the south of Brazil's coffee belt as the warm, high pressure dominating the area continued its hold over the region.
In other news, Kenya has suspended its weekly coffee auctions for the next two weeks because of acute shortages. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
